# CleanMySocial

> CleanMySocial is a set of independently developed Chrome extensions for managing a user's own Facebook, Messenger, and Instagram accounts. The extensions work inside the user's existing browser session. CleanMySocial is not affiliated with Meta, Facebook, Instagram, Google, or Chrome.

Official site: https://cleanmysocial.verblike.com/
Developer and provider: Vladyslav Verbytskyi, independent software developer
Support: info@verblike.com
Pricing: https://cleanmysocial.verblike.com/pricing
Privacy: https://cleanmysocial.verblike.com/privacy
Terms: https://cleanmysocial.verblike.com/terms
Refund policy: https://cleanmysocial.verblike.com/refund
Guides: https://cleanmysocial.verblike.com/blog

## Products

- [Delete All Messages for Facebook & Instagram](https://cleanmysocial.verblike.com/facebook-instagram-cleaner): Bulk delete, archive, or restore Messenger conversations and unsend messages sent by the user's account in an Instagram conversation.
- [Messenger Cleaner – Delete All Facebook Messages](https://cleanmysocial.verblike.com/facebook-messenger-cleaner): Select and clean multiple Facebook Messenger conversations from a Chrome side panel.
- [Mass Friends Remover for Facebook — Bulk Unfriender](https://cleanmysocial.verblike.com/mass-unfriender): Review, select, and remove multiple friends from the user's own Facebook account.
- [Followers Tracker for Instagram – Unfollowers & Bulk Unfollow](https://cleanmysocial.verblike.com/instagram-followers-tracker): Compare scans to identify follower changes. Manual scans and one-by-one unfollows are free; Pro adds daily alerts, bulk unfollow, and CSV or Excel exports.

## Privacy and limitations

- Social credentials, message contents, friend lists, and follower lists are not sent to CleanMySocial as part of extension operation; product-specific details are documented in each extension privacy notice.
- Messenger conversation deletion removes the user's copy and does not remove the other participant's copy.
- Instagram follower history begins with the first scan and cannot reconstruct earlier changes.
- Facebook and Instagram interface or rate-limit changes can temporarily affect browser automation.
- Product ratings and prices shown on product pages should be treated as the current source of truth and may change.
